description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dehipagoda, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320241
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and cadastral information) in various villages. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined for Type 4 classification.
